_comment: How the pipe importer turns diameter bands into assets. Copy this to pipe-segments.json to use it;
without that file the importer creates one asset per band, which is what the source table actually says.
Whatever the rules, a band's segments always sum to its published length to the foot, and splitting the
same band twice gives the same segments. A synthesized segment is a share of a band, not a real pipe.
defaultSegmentLengthFt  cut every band into segments of about this length
minSegmentLengthFt      never leave a stub shorter than this
bands                   rules for named diameters, keyed as the CSV prints them
segmentLengthFt       about this long, for this band
segmentCount          exactly this many, equal length
segments              named by hand; lengths are treated as shares, scaled to the band's real total
